items.title: Everspin and Teledyne HiRel Partner to Offer MRAM for Aerospace and Defense Applications
items.summary: Everspin Technologies (NASDAQ:MRAM) and Teledyne HiRel Semiconductors, a unit of Teledyne Technologies (NYSE:TDY), announced a partnership to make Everspin’s PERSYST spin-transfer torque MRAM available through Teledyne HiRel’s memory product portfolio for aerospace and defense customers. The collaboration will initially focus on Everspin’s 256Mb PERSYST STT-MRAM and will also cover the company’s 64Mb and 128Mb PERSYST products.

items.title: A Rocket Launch Just Highlighted Teledyne’s (TDY) Overlooked Space Business
items.summary: On August 27, Teledyne Technologies (NYSE:TDY) watched a piece of its own hardware ride an Ariane 6 rocket off a pad in French Guiana. The CIS111 detector, built by the company’s Space Imaging unit, launched aboard the Meteosat Third Generation Imager-2 (MTG-I2) satellite, tucked inside an instrument that will help European forecasters spot severe storms […]

items.title: NASA Is About to Launch a Telescope. What That Means for SpaceX, Others.
items.summary: Space is recapturing Americans’ imagination, mainly thanks to  SpaceX  Elon Musk, and his trillion-dollar dreams to make humans a multi-planetary species.  There’s more to space than just SpaceX, which will benefit other shares beyond Musk’s rocket and AI company.  On Sunday, NASA is scheduled to launch the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.

items.title: Why Is Teledyne Technologies (TDY) Drawing Attention Across Defense And AI Infrastructure?
items.summary: Teledyne Technologies (NYSE: TDY), through Teledyne FLIR OEM, has been selected to support the U.S. Army's DUTCH initiative, which is focused on next generation uncooled thermal infrared sensing. The DUTCH program aims to advance domestic capabilities in uncooled thermal imaging and scale advanced sensor technologies for defense applications.
